Summerboard — Companion app for e-boards

Mobile Hardware Product Design UI/UX

Summerboard is an electric board that simulates the feel and experience of snowboarding — carving your commute, or your city, or just the street outside your front door.

We built the companion app to extend what the board can do, and to connect riders to each other.
